verdict.rationale: The docs advertise "Manage dashboards as code" and let you read, download and hand-edit the full dashboard JSON spec, noting an API path also exists. Service accounts provide programmatic API access for CI/CD pipelines, so dashboard JSON provisioning is plausible, though the repeatable-provisioning workflow itself is not documented in depth. Alerts-as-code is barely evidenced, appearing only indirectly through AI agent skills and MCP tooling that can manage alerts. Missing for 10: Terraform provider evidence, documented alert JSON/API provisioning, a published API spec (the OpenAPI probes returned 404), a detailed GitOps/repeatable-provisioning guide, and independent hands-on corroboration.
